
# Thesis Guidelines

To write a thesis which conforms to the guidelines set by MCI, a LaTeX standard
was written, called `mcidoc` which its source file can be accessed in its
[GitHub Repo](https://github.com/dTmC0945/C-MCI-LaTeX-Class-mcidoc).

There are two (2) branches in which you need to use the `main` branch as the
`develop` branch can contain **unstable** code.

To access its documentation you can have a look at it [here](https://dtmc0945.github.io/C-MCI-LaTeX-Class-mcidoc/).

::: {.callout-important}
## A Thorough Refreshment on LaTeX
If you need a *good-ish* documentation on how to use LaTeX, please have a look
at the lecture repo [L-MCI-BSc-Academic-Writing](https://github.com/dTmC0945/L-MCI-BSc-Academic-Writing) which contains material for
starting to work with LaTeX.
:::
